domains.name: Aspire
domains.responsibilities: Orchestrates polyglot containers (Postgres, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Keycloak, TimescaleDB, Elasticsearch, Qdrant, Ollama) and wires inter-service telemetry, resilience, and discovery.

domains.name: BuildingBlocks
domains.responsibilities: Reusable microservices chassis packaging CQRS pipelines, Wolverine durable Outbox/Inbox, Marten Event Store, FusionCache, Keycloak PKCE/Token Exchange, and domain base primitives.

domains.name: Gateway
domains.responsibilities: YARP reverse proxy edge routing with dynamic Aspire service discovery and JWT bearer authentication.

domains.name: FlagshipExecutionSlice
domains.responsibilities: End-to-end showcase of all 24 enterprise capabilities: Vertical Slice Architecture, Marten Event Sourcing, Wolverine Outbox, gRPC matching, MassTransit compensation saga, and Ollama multi-agent AI.

domains.name: SupportingServices
domains.responsibilities: Keycloak admin user/permission management, external broker connectivity, SignalR market streams, margin checks, positions, and Elasticsearch compliance logging.

domains.name: Clients
domains.responsibilities: Webpack 5 Module Federation microfrontends with Keycloak PKCE, real-time trading terminals, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.
